game_title: Type Sorter – Lava Tube Tunnel Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling cooling flasks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Sort falling cooling flasks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about sorted_ok to power up the volcanologist and open the summit beacon.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
